description: This header file declares utility functions related to variable argument functions used in Torch's Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation runtime. The functions handle operations such as unpacking and constructing tuples, lists, dictionaries, type checking, and object creation within the JIT runtime stack.

methods.name: tupleUnpack
methods.description: Unpacks a tuple from the stack into individual elements.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Performs string formatting operations based on the inputs on the stack.

methods.name: einsum
methods.description: Performs Einstein summation convention operations on the inputs.

methods.name: listUnpack
methods.description: Unpacks a list from the stack into individual elements.

methods.name: tupleConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a tuple from inputs on the stack.

methods.name: namedTupleConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a named tuple using a specified type.

methods.name: listConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a list with a specified type from inputs.

methods.name: dictConstruct
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary from key-value pairs.

methods.name: createObject
methods.description: Creates a new object of a specified class type, optionally as a weak reference, for use within the JIT graph.

methods.name: isinstance
methods.description: Checks if the object on the stack is an instance of any of the specified types.

methods.name: tupleSlice
methods.description: Creates a slice of a tuple from the stack, given start and end indices.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Performs dequantization on data from the stack.
